commands:
cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit << 'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Git pre-commit hook to run mypy type checking

echo "Running mypy type checking on src/..."
mypy src/

# Exit with the same code as mypy
exit $?
EOF
grep -i "ignore" pyproject.toml || echo "No ignore settings found"

cat >> pyproject.toml << 'EOF'

[mypy-tests.*]
disallow_untyped_defs = false

[mypy-src.*]
# Using incremental mode to focus on new/changed code
incremental = true
EOF

cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit << 'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Git pre-commit hook to run mypy type checking on staged Python files

echo "Running mypy type checking..."

# Get staged Python files
STAGED_PYTHON_FILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep "\.py$")

if [ -n "$STAGED_PYTHON_FILES" ]; then
    # Run mypy only on staged files
    mypy $STAGED_PYTHON_FILES
    exit $?
else
    echo "No Python files staged. Skipping mypy check."
    exit 0
fi
EOF
